title: Make UpgradeDefaultDimensions ParentId backfill set-based (via DataTransfer)
summary: The UpgradeDefaultDimensions procedure now uses set-based DataTransfer operations instead of row-by-row processing to backfill ParentId fields in Default Dimension records, significantly reducing upgrade runtime on large tables.
key_points: Replaces per-row Get and Modify operations with four set-based DataTransfer joins (Item, Customer, Vendor, Employee)
Scopes destination rows by Table ID and blank ParentId to prevent cross-matching between entity types
Preserves existing behavior while reducing SQL round-trips from millions to a single set-based operation
Applied consistently across all localization layers (W1, AT, BE, CH, IT, NL, NO, RU)
Audit fields are intentionally not restamped, consistent with other upgrade DataTransfer operations
quote: Replace the loop with four set-based DataTransfer joins (Item, Customer, Vendor, Employee), consistent with the Parent Type / DimensionId steps in the same method.
